fund_analytics_monthly_metrics.title: Fund Analytics Monthly Metrics (Consolidated Member Model)
fund_analytics_monthly_metrics.business_narrative: Executive C-Suite scorecard for Sanlam Corporate Umbrella Funds. Communicates overall fund scale, capital adequacy, assets under administration (AUA) vs multi-manager assets under management (AUM), monthly employer and member contributions, and total fund operational friction (admin fees + risk premiums). Key sign-off metric is the Average Funding Level (77.5%) across active participating members.

visual_layout.title: Total AUA and AUM Trajectory (2024-2025)
Gross Contributions vs Fund Costs by Fund Category

member_monthly.title: Member Monthly (Full Fund Analytics Galaxy)
member_monthly.business_narrative: Detailed member-grain monthly analytics covering retirement savings buckets (Vested vs Savings vs Retirement Pots), employee/employer contribution splits, billed fees, and risk premiums across all participating schemes.

visual_layout.title: Two-Pot Allocation Breakdown: Vested vs Savings vs Retirement
Monthly Employer vs Member Contributions

member_transactions.title: SC Member Transactions Journal
member_transactions.business_narrative: Detailed transaction audit journal. Communicates monthly transaction velocity, volume of unit allocations, trading prices, and transacting member counts across contribution, fee, market valuation, and risk premium transactions.

visual_layout.title: Monthly Transaction Value by Category
Transacting Member Count Velocity

assetflows_member_monthly.title: SC Asset Flows & Claims Reconciler
assetflows_member_monthly.business_narrative: Reconciliation of fund cashflows and claim settlements. Communicates net asset flows (contributions minus benefit payouts), claim processing velocity, death/disability benefits, and retirement lump sums.

visual_layout.title: Gross Contributions vs Claims Paid Flow
Claims Paid Distribution by Claim Type

digital_portal.title: SC Digital Portal Overview
digital_portal.business_narrative: Comprehensive digital transformation dashboard. Communicates member digital adoption velocity, registration vs deregistration trends, session frequency, and feature utilisation. Highlighting self-service engagement following Two-Pot retirement system implementation.

digital_portal_events.title: SC Digital Portal Events Telemetry
digital_portal_events.business_narrative: Detailed technical telemetry of digital portal user interactions. Communicates session depth, device channels, error-free completion rates, and peak usage hours for member servicing capacity planning.

visual_layout.title: Hourly Event Traffic Velocity by Channel

digital_portal_registrations.title: SC Digital Portal Registrations Lifecycle
digital_portal_registrations.business_narrative: Monitors member registration lifecycle, self-service onboarding conversion, and credential renewals. Tracks net member digital growth across participating funds and employers.

Registration Volume by Employer Group

aggregated_digital_portal_registrations.title: SC Aggregated Digital Portal Registrations (Demographics)
aggregated_digital_portal_registrations.business_narrative: Demographic and segmentation analysis of digital portal adoption. Slices registration adoption by age band, salary band, gender, marital status, and employer to highlight underserved cohorts for targeted digital literacy campaigns.

annuity_quotation.business_narrative: Tracks pre-retirement conversion into guaranteed retail and corporate annuities. Communicates quotation pipeline health, quoted vs accepted conversion rate, average quote purchase price, and projected monthly guaranteed payout obligations. Key sign-off metric is the 40.2% Quote Conversion Rate and R 1.94 B bound pipeline.

visual_layout.title: Monthly Quoted Purchase Price vs Conversion Rate
Quotation Volume by Annuity Product Group

in_fund_exit_member_monthly.title: SC In-Fund Exit (INFUSE) Preservation
in_fund_exit_member_monthly.business_narrative: Tracks retirement benefit preservation when members resign from their employer. Communicates how effectively Sanlam prevents retirement leakage into cash withdrawals by converting exiting members into In-Fund Preserved members. Key metric is the 48.6% Retention Rate.

visual_layout.title: Preserved AUA Growth vs Outflow Leakage (2024-2025)
Preservation Retention Rate by Movement Reason

investments_fundamental.title: SC Fundamental Investments & Client Value
investments_fundamental.business_narrative: Institutional and multi-manager investment portfolio reporting. Communicates institutional portfolio market values, capital flows (inflows vs outflows), smoothed bonus fund stability, and manager allocation breakdown. Reconciled against Hiport investment records.

visual_layout.title: Monthly Inflows vs Outflows and Net Growth
Asset Distribution: Smoothed Bonus vs Market-Linked

member_monthly_investment.title: SC Investment Risk Rating & Portfolios
member_monthly_investment.business_narrative: Portfolio risk suitability and asset allocation dashboard. Communicates distribution of member retirement savings across risk meter bands (Aggressive, Moderate-Aggressive, Moderate, Conservative, Capital Guaranteed) sliced by member age and salary bands to ensure compliance with default investment regulations.
